How to update a go module version

by Joe Blogs

To update a go module to a specific Go version, you can use the go mod edit command. For example, to set the Go version to 1.24.4, you would run the following command in your terminal:

go mod edit -go=1.24.4

If you want to set the Go version to the current version installed on your system, you can use the following command:

go mod edit -go="$(go env GOVERSION | sed 's/^go//')"
